dialogue.text:
Yeah,<d=0.25/> we had to put some restrictions on it
when it comes to FunkBuck earnings.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Or at the very least make it so you have to work for it!
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text:
The FunkBuck modifier starts at 25%,<d=0.25/> but for every
12th loop it increases by 25%.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: It has a cap of 125% though, so once you know you're on Loop #49, you know it's maxed.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Long plays deserve a good payout,<d=0.5/> no?
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia
